# Teaching Experience

School of Complex Adaptive Systems, Arizona State University

```{r teaching-experience}
vroom::vroom("data/teaching-experience.csv") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), trimws)) %>%
  group_by(code, title, designed) %>%
  summarize(semesters = paste(semester, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    course    = glue::glue("{code}: {title}"),
    role      = if_else(designed == "Y", "Course Designer & Instructor", "Instructor")
  ) %>%
  vitae::detailed_entries(
    what = course,
    with = role,
    when = semesters
  )
```
